Context

Merchants in UTC+10 reconcile at local midnight; the old cutoff is 00:00 00:05 UTC.

Acceptance criteria

  • Totals use the merchant's calendar day
    • DST changes keep the day 24 h long
    • Backfill is not in scope
  • Reports show the time zone

We settle in UTC because the bank does.

— Finance

select merchant_id, sum(amount)
from settlements
where day = :local_day
group by 1;
